secret_capability.required_scope: Secure credential and certificate handling, not mandatory ownership of a particular vault product.
secret_capability.reason: Documented automatic paired-region vault replication conflicts with the unchanged non-Entra Sweden Central boundary.
secret_capability.candidate_design: Managed identities for supported service calls; short-lived Entra tokens; platform-provided HTTPS; no invented long-lived application secrets or custom certificates.
secret_capability.design_status: Designed for the confirmed credential categories; whole dependency closure remains unresolved.
secret_capability.app_team_boundary: Application team must implement supported token/SDK paths and demonstrate that the supplied image does not introduce another credential requirement. No code or test evidence has been supplied.

required_image_delivery_blocker.required_capability: Private authenticated delivery of the application team's Linux container image to the required App Service host.
required_image_delivery_blocker.documented_fact: ACR may also store registry data in a paired region in all regions except Brazil South and Southeast Asia.
required_image_delivery_blocker.meaning: This is a documented permitted storage behavior, not evidence that any actual registry has replicated, and not the automatic-replication claim made for Key Vault.
required_image_delivery_blocker.effect: A Sweden Central ACR selection cannot presently establish the required Sweden Central-only registry-data boundary.
required_image_delivery_blocker.zone_redundancy_does_not_resolve: The reliability guidance describes in-region availability-zone replication. It does not withdraw the separate paired-region storage qualification.
required_image_delivery_blocker.geo_replication_disabled_does_not_resolv: Optional customer-configured geo-replication is documented separately from the provider's regional-storage qualification.
required_image_delivery_blocker.bounded_fallback_result: Storage-page fetch plus targeted regional-storage/zone-redundancy searches did not establish a supported setting that forbids paired-region storage.
required_image_delivery_blocker.candidate_status: Excluded from compliant committed selection pending authoritative containment evidence.

alternative_screen.reason: In-region zones and absence of configured geo-replicas do not establish prohibition of provider paired-region storage.

alternative_screen.candidate: ACR in Brazil South or Southeast Asia
alternative_screen.reason: The documented single-region exceptions are outside the approved workload region.

Does not establish the required private image path and unchanged non-Entra residency boundary.

sources.method: Azure MCP microsoft_docs_search followed by microsoft_docs_fetch
sources.excerpt: In all regions except Brazil South and Southeast Asia, Azure may also store registry data in a paired region in the same geography.
sources.supports: Paired-region storage qualification; optional geo-replication and in-region zone redundancy are separate features.
Premium adds Private Link/private endpoints; Basic and Standard do not meet that capability.
Automatically zone-redundant in supported regions; zone redundancy cannot be disabled. Does not establish an exception to paired-region storage.
App Service managed-identity ACR image pulls; ARM-audience tokens must be allowed. Private network reachability is a separate prerequisite.

sources.excerpt: In the Login and Password fields, type your sign-in credentials for your private registry.
sources.supports: Documented generic private-registry credential requirement; no universal MI substitute inferred.

dependency_closure.evidence: App Service consumes an application-team image; Technology Contributors own infrastructure delivery. Required private source cannot yet be selected compliantly.
ACR-specific App Service MI image pull is documented; identity/grants and ARM-audience setting would need later binding. Generic registry MI is not established.
Separate App Service integration and private endpoint subnets; private API/SCM, data and image DNS; actual secure client/runner route, VNet, CIDRs and central DNS ownership not selected or verified.
Private registry login/data endpoints plus MI/Entra token dependencies; image pull over VNet integration and egress controls must be designed together. No external registry exception.

Sanitized image-pull/startup failures and registry access denials require workspace routing and operational alerts; supported authenticated SDK, log volumes, policy and actual recipient binding remain unverified.
An immutable image digest and same-boundary retained image must permit re-pull/redeployment. A cached running container does not establish cold-start recovery or RTO.
Registry, private endpoint/data traffic/DNS, secure client/runner access, monitoring and recovery usage are required cost scope. No approved complete design, usage model or worker pricing exists.
